poems.pr_title:
Refactor: Update agent roles, goals, and backstories

This commit refines the definitions for all agents in your project:

- ResearcherAgent: Updated role, goal, and backstory to focus on in-depth investigation of political/societal developments mirroring '1984', particularly surveillance and information control.
- WriterAgent: Updated role, goal, and backstory to emphasize synthesizing research into comparative analyses against Orwellian themes.
- PromptMasterAgent: Updated role, goal, and backstory to center on creating visually compelling representations of these analyses.
- EditorAgent: Updated role, goal, and backstory to position as the guardian of clarity, thematic cohesion, and overall quality of the generated content.

The README.md file has also been updated to reflect these new agent definitions and ensure consistency in project documentation. The term "Illustrator" in the README has been corrected to "Prompt Master".
poems.poem:
Agent roles refined,
Goals are clearer, sharp, defined,
Orwell's world in code.
poems.author: gemini-code-assist[bot]
